##### Project general facts

Casa Noi is a villa resort by Land Scout Asia offering a collection of one- and two-storey villas with one and two bedrooms. The architecture fuses Mediterranean charm with tropical minimalism: terracotta-red facades with bold black-and-white awnings give the community a Riviera spirit. Each villa comes with a private garden terrace and a sala, designed with both everyday living and short-term rental appeal in mind.

Residents enjoy a full suite of resort-style amenities. The grounds include swimming pools with a pool bar, a café, a gym, a hammam and sauna, an outdoor cinema, a barbecue zone and a kids' zone. The community also has exclusive access to a serene stretch of the Gulf coast nearby, where private sun loungers are reserved for residents.

Interiors follow a Tropical Deco concept: vaulted ceilings with woven reed textures, handcrafted furniture, artisanal lighting, terrazzo floors and a designer palette of indigo, sand and sunset tones. Selected two-bedroom villas feature a private jacuzzi. The villas are delivered fully furnished and rental-ready.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Chaweng Noi is a quiet, green coastal neighbourhood on the east coast of Koh Samui, set between the island's two most popular beach destinations, Chaweng and Lamai. The area rises gently behind Chaweng Noi Beach and is surrounded by palm groves, top-rated resorts, private villas and wellness retreats, while staying close to the liveliest part of the island.

Samui International Airport, Central Festival Samui and the restaurants, beach clubs and nightlife of Chaweng are a short drive away, as are Bophut and Fisherman's Village to the north and Lamai to the south. The island ring road links the neighbourhood with the rest of Koh Samui, and international schools, private hospitals and supermarkets are within easy reach.

Koh Samui is one of Thailand's premier tourist destinations, served by its own international airport and welcoming visitors all year round, which supports a strong short-term rental market. Chaweng Noi is favoured by tourists, digital nomads and long-stay guests for its balance of nature, access and prestige, allowing owners to command premium nightly rates. Property in the area is offered on a leasehold basis, with land held through a Thai company structure.
